card.summary_ko: 《고려사》 권94 열전 중 서희(942–998) 전기 전체(성종 12년, 993년 거란 소손녕과의 담판 포함). 외교 담판으로 거란의 침공을 막고 압록강 이남 땅 확보의 길을 연 과정을 그린다.
card.summary_en: The complete biography of Seo Hui (942-998) from Goryeo-sa vol. 94, including his negotiation in 993 with the Khitan commander Xiao Sunning, by which he turned back an invasion and opened the way to winning territory south of the Yalu.
card.edition_ko: 중국어 위키문헌 「高麗史/卷九十四」 (개정 2109098, 2022-02-23)에서 〈徐熙〉 전기만 수록 — 맨 앞의 표제(‘徐熙訥、恭’)에 이어 서희의 출생·관직부터 죽음과 추증, 자식(‘子訥，側室子周行’)까지의 열네 문단. 이어지는 서눌 이하 전기는 없음. 담판은 이 중간 부분(993년 기사). 원저작 퍼블릭 도메인, 전사 CC BY-SA 4.0, 원문만·번역 없음
card.edition_en: Chinese Wikisource 「高麗史/卷九十四」 (revision 2109098, 2022-02-23): only the biography of Seo Hui, from the page heading ('徐熙訥、恭') through his career, the 993 negotiation, his death and honours, ending at a line on his son Nul and a concubine's son. The biographies that follow (Seo Nul onward) are not included. The negotiation is in the middle of the text (the entries for 993). Original in the public domain, transcription CC BY-SA 4.0. Original text only, no translation.

notes.ko:
**저자** 정인지(1396–1478)는 조선 초기의 문신·학자로 본관은 하동입니다. 1414년 문과에 장원급제하고 세종 때 집현전에서 활동하며 《훈민정음》 해례본의 후서를 쓰고 《용비어천가》 편찬에 참여했습니다. 《고려사》(1451)는 정인지가 김종서 등과 함께 편찬 책임을 진 관찬 사서입니다. 1453년 계유정난 때 수양대군(세조) 편에 서서 공신이 되었고 세조 때 영의정에 올라, 단종 쪽 신하들이 희생된 정변에 협력한 인물이라는 비판적 평가도 있습니다. 《고려사》는 유교적 사관으로 쓴 조선 왕조의 공식 역사서이므로, 고려 인물에 대한 서술에는 조선 초 관료들의 시각이 반영되어 있습니다.

**시대적 맥락** 993년 거란(요)의 소손녕이 대군을 이끌고 고려를 침입하자 조정에서는 땅을 떼어 주고 화친하자는 논의까지 나왔다고 전합니다. 서희는 거란 진영에 나아가 담판을 벌여, 고려가 고구려의 후계라는 점과 압록강 일대의 여진 때문에 교류가 막혀 있다는 점을 내세워 군대를 물리게 했고, 이후 압록강 동쪽(강동 6주)에 성을 쌓는 것도 인정받았습니다. 이 기록은 4세기 반 이상 뒤인 조선 초에 정리된 것으로, 서희의 외교는 후대에 담판 외교의 모범으로 자주 언급되었습니다.

**배경**
《고려사》는 조선 초 정인지 등이 1451년에 완성한 고려 왕조의 정사이다. 열전은 인물별 전기이며, 권94는 서희로 시작한다. 서희(徐熙, 942–998)는 광종·성종 때의 문신으로, 이 판은 그의 전기를 처음부터 끝까지 싣는다.

**내용 (이 판 전체)**
- 출신과 이력: 광종 11년(960) 열여덟에 갑과에 급제하고, 광종 23년(972) 송에 사신으로 가 검교병부상서를 받는다. 성종 때 병관어사 등을 지내며 임금이 서경 영명사에 미행하려는 것을 상소로 말린다.
- 993년의 담판: 성종 12년 거란 동경유수 소손녕이 침입해 봉산군을 깨뜨리자 서희는 중군사로 북계에 나간다. 소손녕은 고구려 옛 땅을 차지했다며 항복을 요구하고 ‘80만 군’을 말한다. 조정에서는 서경 이북을 떼어 주자는 의견이 나오고 성종은 서경의 쌀을 대동강에 버리게 하려 하지만, 서희는 식량이 있으면 싸울 수 있다고 막고, 이지백도 땅을 떼어 주는 일에 반대한다. 이어 서희가 홀로 나서 사절이 된다. 소손녕이 뜰에서 절하라고 요구하나 서희는 맞절을 고집해 관철한다. 소손녕이 고구려 땅의 소유와 송과의 교류를 문제 삼자, 서희는 나라 이름이 ‘고려’이고 평양에 도읍했으니 고구려를 잇는 나라이며 오히려 거란의 동경도 고려 땅에 걸쳐 있다고 답하고, 압록강 안팎을 여진이 가로막아 사신 왕래가 어렵다고 말한다. 소손녕은 이를 보고하고, 거란 황제는 화의를 받아 군사를 거두게 한다. 서희는 7일 머문 뒤 낙타·말·양·비단 등을 선물로 받아 돌아온다.
- 이후: 이듬해부터 서희는 군사를 이끌어 여진을 몰아내고 장흥·귀화 등 진과 곽·귀 등 주에 성을 쌓는다(흔히 ‘강동 6주’라 부르는 지역과 관련됨; 이 글에는 3년에 걸친 축성 기록으로 나온다). 이어 해주에서의 일화, 간언한 정우현을 옹호한 일이 있고, 병이 깊어지자 성종이 문병한다. 목종 원년(998)에 57세로 죽으며 시호는 장위, 후에 성종 묘정에 배향되고 태사로 추증된다. 끝은 아들 서눌과 측실 아들을 언급하는 한 줄이다.

**의의**
말로 싸움을 막은 외교의 사례로 널리 알려져 있다. 다만 ‘80만 대군’은 소손녕이 한 말이고 실제 병력은 알 수 없다. 이 글은 조선 초 편찬 사서의 서술이므로 담판 장면의 대화는 후대 기록의 형태로 읽어야 한다.

**읽기 도움**
- 中軍使: 군 지휘관 직함. 平章事: 재상급 관직.
- 大朝·上國: 소손녕이 거란을 가리킨 말.
- 高勾麗舊地: 고구려의 옛 땅(양측의 주장 근거).
- 生女眞: 압록강 일대의 여진 집단.
- 割地: 영토를 떼어 줌. 禮幣使: 예물을 가져가는 사절.
- 拜下·分庭揖: 뜰에서 절하는 예와, 마당을 나누어 서서 읍하는 대등한 예.
- 燃燈·八關·仙郞: 고려의 전통 의례.
- 譙周: 촉한에서 위에 항복을 권한 인물(이지백이 인용).
- 營·館: 군영과 숙소.
notes.en:
**About the author** Jeong In-ji (1396–1478), of the Hadong Jeong clan, was an early Joseon official and scholar. He placed first in the civil examination in 1414, worked in the Hall of Worthies under Sejong, wrote the postface of the Hunminjeongeum Haerye and took part in compiling the Yongbi eocheon ga. The Goryeo-sa (1451) is an official history for which he was one of those responsible, together with Kim Jong-seo and others. In 1453 he sided with Prince Suyang (later Sejo) in the Gyeyu coup, was named a merit subject and rose to chief state councillor under Sejo; some judge him harshly for cooperating in the coup that cost the lives of officials loyal to Danjong. Because the Goryeo-sa is an official Joseon history written from a Confucian viewpoint, its portrayal of Goryeo figures reflects the outlook of early Joseon officials.

**Historical context** In 993 the Khitan (Liao) general Xiao Sunning invaded Goryeo with a large army, and the court is said to have even discussed ceding land to buy peace. Seo Hui went to the Khitan camp and negotiated, arguing that Goryeo was heir to Goguryeo and that the Jurchen along the Yalu were what blocked contact; the army withdrew, and Goryeo was later allowed to build fortresses east of the Yalu (the 'Six Garrisons of Gangdong'). This account was compiled in early Joseon, some four and a half centuries later, and Seo Hui's diplomacy was often cited afterwards as a model of negotiation.

**Background**
The Goryeo-sa is the official history of the Goryeo dynasty, completed in 1451 by Jeong In-ji and others in early Joseon. Its biographies (yeoljeon) are person-by-person accounts, and volume 94 opens with Seo Hui. Seo Hui (942-998) was an official under Gwangjong and Seongjong; this edition gives his biography from beginning to end.

**Contents (the whole edition)**
- Origins and career: in year 11 of Gwangjong (960), aged eighteen, he passes the top-class examination; in year 23 (972) he goes to Song as envoy and is given an honorary title. Under Seongjong he holds office and dissuades the king by memorial from a secret outing to Yeongmyeong temple in Pyongyang.
- The negotiation of 993: in year 12 of Seongjong the Khitan commander Xiao Sunning invades and takes Bongsan; Seo Hui goes north as commander of the central army. Xiao claims the old Goguryeo land, demands surrender and speaks of "800,000 troops". At court some propose ceding land north of Pyongyang, and the king has the stored grain dumped in the Taedong river, but Seo Hui objects that with food they can fight, and Yi Ji-baek also opposes ceding land. Seo Hui alone volunteers as envoy. When Xiao demands that he bow in the courtyard he insists on an equal greeting and prevails. Xiao accuses Goryeo of encroaching on Goguryeo land and of dealing with Song; Seo Hui replies that the name Goryeo and the capital at Pyongyang show Goryeo is Goguryeo's heir, that even Khitan's Eastern Capital overlaps Goryeo territory, and that the Jurchen block the roads on both sides of the Yalu. Xiao reports this, and the Khitan emperor accepts peace and calls off the army. Seo Hui stays seven days and returns with gifts of camels, horses, sheep and silks.
- Afterwards: from the next year he leads troops to drive out the Jurchen and builds forts and walled towns such as Jangheung and Gwihwa and the prefectures Gwak and Gu (related to what is usually called the "six garrisons east of the river"; here it appears as fortification records over three years). Then come an anecdote at Haeju and his defence of an official who had criticised policy; Seongjong visits him when he falls ill. He dies in the first year of Mokjong (998), aged 57, with the posthumous name Jangwi, and is later honoured in Seongjong's shrine and posthumously made Grand Preceptor. The text ends with a line about his son Nul and a concubine's son.

**Significance**
The negotiation is famous as a case of averting war by argument. "Eight hundred thousand troops" was Xiao's own claim; the real strength is unknown. As a history compiled in early Joseon, the speeches should be read as a later account.

**Reading help**
- 中軍使: a military command title; 平章事: chief-minister rank.
- 大朝, 上國: how Xiao refers to the Khitan state.
- 高勾麗舊地: Goguryeo's old land, the basis of both sides' claims.
- 生女眞: Jurchen groups around the Yalu.
- 割地: cede territory; 禮幣使: envoy bearing gifts.
- 拜下, 分庭揖: bowing in the courtyard versus the equal bow across a divided court.
- 燃燈, 八關, 仙郞: Goryeo's traditional rites.
- 譙周: the Shu Han official who urged surrender to Wei (cited by Yi Ji-baek).
- 營, 館: camp and lodging.

paragraphs.en: Seo Hui, Seo Nul and Seo Gong

paragraphs.orig: 徐熙，小字廉允，內議令弼子也。性嚴恪。光宗十一年，年十八擢甲科，超授廣評員外郞，累遷內議侍郞。
paragraphs.reading: 서희, 소자염윤, 내의령필자야. 성엄각. 광종십일년, 연십팔탁갑과, 초수광평원외랑, 누천내의시랑.
paragraphs.en: Seo Hui, whose childhood name was Yeomyun, was the son of Pil, Director of the Naeui Office. He was strict and reverent by nature. In the eleventh year of King Gwangjong, at the age of eighteen, he was raised to the top class in the examinations and, advanced beyond the usual ranks, was appointed Supernumerary Secretary of the Gwangpyeong Council; after repeated promotions he became Vice-Minister of the Naeui Office.

paragraphs.orig: 二十三年，奉使如宋，時不朝宋十數年，熙至，容儀中度，宋太祖嘉之，授檢校兵部尙書。
paragraphs.reading: 이십삼년, 봉사여송, 시불조송십수년, 희지, 용의중도, 송태조가지, 수검교병부상서.
paragraphs.en: In the twenty-third year he went to Song as an envoy. At that time Goryeo had not paid court to Song for more than ten years; when Hui arrived, his bearing and demeanour were so fitting that Emperor Taizu of Song praised him and conferred on him the title of Acting Minister of War.

paragraphs.orig: 成宗二年，由佐丞，拜兵官御事。從幸西京，成宗欲微行遊永明寺，熙上䟽諫。乃止，賜鞍馬以賞之，後改內史侍郞。
paragraphs.reading: 성종이년, 유좌승, 배병관어사. 종행서경, 성종욕미행유영명사, 희상소간. 내지, 사안마이상지, 후개내사시랑.
paragraphs.en: In the second year of King Seongjong, he was promoted from Assistant Councillor and appointed Director of the Office of War. He accompanied the king on a visit to the Western Capital, where Seongjong wished to go out in disguise and tour Yeongmyeong Temple; Hui submitted a memorial remonstrating, and the king desisted. The king rewarded him with a saddled horse, and later Hui was made Vice-Minister of the Naesa.

paragraphs.orig: 十二年，契丹來侵，熙爲中軍使，與侍中朴良柔、門下侍郞崔亮，軍于北界備之。成宗欲自將禦之，幸西京，進次安北府。契丹東京留守蕭遜寧，攻破蓬山郡，獲我先鋒軍使、給事中尹庶顔等，成宗聞之，不得進乃還。熙引兵欲救蓬山，遜寧聲言：「大朝旣已奄有高勾麗舊地，今爾國侵奪疆界，是以來討。」又移書云：「大朝統一四方，其未歸附，期於掃蕩。速致降款，毋涉淹留。」熙見書，還奏有可和之狀，成宗遣監察司憲、借禮賓少卿李蒙戩，如契丹營請和。遜寧又移書云：「八十萬兵至矣，若不出江而降，當須殄滅，君臣宜速降軍前。」蒙戩至營，問所以來侵之意，遜寧曰：「汝國不恤民事，是用恭行天罰，若欲求和，宜速來降。」
paragraphs.reading: 십이년, 거란래침, 희위중군사, 여시중박양유, 문하시랑최량, 군우북계비지. 성종욕자장어지, 행서경, 진차안북부. 거란동경유수소손녕, 공파봉산군, 획아선봉군사, 급사중윤서안등, 성종문지, 부득진내환. 희인병욕구봉산, 손녕성언: 「대조기이엄유고구려구지, 금이국침탈강계, 시이래토.」 우이서운: 「대조통일사방, 기미귀부, 기어소탕. 속치항관, 무섭엄류.」 희견서, 환주유가화지상, 성종견감찰사헌, 차예빈소경이몽전, 여거란영청화. 손녕우이서운: 「팔십만병지의, 약불출강이항, 당수진멸, 군신의속항군전.」 몽전지영, 문소이래침지의, 손녕왈: 「여국불휼민사, 시용공행천벌, 약욕구화, 의속래항.」
paragraphs.en: In the twelfth year the Khitan invaded. Hui, as Commander of the Central Army, together with Chancellor Park Yang-yu and Vice-Minister of the Chancellery Choe Yang, encamped in the northern frontier region to guard against them. King Seongjong wished to lead the army himself to repel them; he went to the Western Capital and advanced to Anbuk Garrison. The Khitan Governor of the Eastern Capital, So Son-nyeong, attacked and broke the county of Bongsan and captured our Vanguard Commissioner, the Palace Secretary Yun Seo-an, and others. When Seongjong heard of this, he could go no further and turned back. Hui led troops to relieve Bongsan, but Son-nyeong declared: “The Great Dynasty has long since come to possess the old land of Goguryeo, and now your country has encroached upon and seized our borders. That is why we have come to punish you.” He also sent a letter: “The Great Dynasty unifies the four quarters, and those who have not yet submitted are sworn to be swept away. Send your surrender at once, and do not linger.” When Hui saw the letter, he returned and reported to the king that there appeared to be grounds for peace. Seongjong sent the Censor Yi Mong-jeon, acting Vice-Minister of Protocol, to the Khitan camp to sue for peace. Son-nyeong again sent a letter: “Eight hundred thousand troops have arrived! If you do not come out across the river and surrender, you will surely be annihilated. Ruler and ministers should hasten to surrender before our army.” When Mong-jeon reached the camp and asked why they had come to invade, Son-nyeong said: “Your country has no care for the welfare of its people, and so we are respectfully carrying out Heaven’s punishment. If you wish to seek peace, you should come quickly and surrender.”

paragraphs.orig: 蒙戩還，成宗會群臣議之。或言車駕還京，令重臣率軍乞降。或言割西京以北與之，自黃州至岊嶺，畫爲封疆。成宗將從割地之議，開西京倉米，任百姓所取，餘者尙多，成宗恐爲敵所資，令投大同江。熙奏曰：「食足則城可守，戰可勝也。兵之勝負，不在强弱，但能觀釁而動耳。何可遽令弃之乎，况食者民之命也，寧爲敵所資，虛弃江中？又恐不合天意，成宗然而止之。
paragraphs.reading: 몽전환, 성종회군신의지. 혹언거가환경, 령중신솔군걸항. 혹언할서경이북여지, 자황주지절령, 획위봉강. 성종장종할지지의, 개서경창미, 임백성소취, 여자상다, 성종공위적소자, 령투대동강. 희주왈: 「식족즉성가수, 전가승야. 병지승부, 부재강약, 단능관흔이동이. 하가거령기지호, 황식자민지명야, 영위적소자, 허기강중?」 우공불합천의, 성종연이지지.
paragraphs.en: When Mong-jeon returned, King Seongjong assembled his ministers to deliberate. Some said that the royal carriage should return to the capital and that senior ministers should lead the army to beg for surrender. Others said that the land north of the Western Capital should be ceded to them, with the border drawn from Hwangju to Jeolryeong Pass. Seongjong was about to follow the proposal to cede land. He opened the rice granaries of the Western Capital and let the people take what they would; a great deal still remained, and fearing it would supply the enemy, he ordered it thrown into the Daedong River. Hui submitted: “If food is sufficient, the city can be held and battles can be won. Victory or defeat in war lies not in strength or weakness, but only in being able to read the enemy’s weakness and strike. How can we suddenly order the grain thrown away? Moreover, food is the very life of the people. Better that it should supply the enemy than that we waste it by casting it into the river, surely? I fear, too, that it would not accord with Heaven’s will.” Seongjong agreed and stopped it.

paragraphs.orig: 熙又奏曰：「自契丹東京，至我安北府，數百里之地，皆爲生女眞所據，光宗取之，築嘉州、松城等城。今契丹之來，其志不過取此二城，其聲言取高勾麗舊地者，實恐我也。今見其兵勢大盛，遽割西京以北與之，非計也。且三角山以北，亦高勾麗舊地，彼以谿壑之欲，責之無厭，可盡與乎？况割地與敵，萬世之恥也，願駕還都城，使臣等一與之戰，然後議之，未晩也。」前民官御事李知白奏曰：「聖祖創業垂統，洎于今日，無一忠臣，遽欲以土地，輕與敵國，可不痛哉，古人有詩云：『千里山河輕孺子，兩朝冠劒恨譙周。』盖謂譙周爲蜀大臣，勸後主納土於魏，爲千古所笑也。請以金銀寶器賂遜寧，以觀其意。且與其輕割土地，弃之敵國，曷若復行先王燃燈、八關、仙郞等事，不爲他方異法，以保國家致太平乎？若以爲然，則當先告神明，然後戰之與和，惟上裁之。」成宗然之。時成宗，樂慕華風，國人不喜，故知白及之。
paragraphs.reading: 희우주왈: 「자거란동경, 지아안북부, 수백리지지, 개위생여진소거, 광종취지, 축가주송성등성. 금거란지래, 기지불과취차이성, 기성언취고구려구지자, 실공아야. 금견기병세대성, 거할서경이북여지, 비계야. 차삼각산이북, 역고구려구지, 피이계학지욕, 책지무염, 가진여호? 황할지여적, 만세지치야, 원가환도성, 사신등일여지전, 연후의지, 미만야.」 전민관어사이지백주왈: 「성조창업수통, 계우금일, 무일충신, 거욕이토지, 경여적국, 가불통재, 고인유시운: 『천리산하경유자, 양조관검한초주.』 개위초주위촉대신, 권후주납토어위, 위천고소소야. 청이금은보기뢰손녕, 이관기의. 차여기경할토지, 기지적국, 갈약부행선왕연등, 팔관, 선랑등사, 불위타방이법, 이보국가치태평호? 약이위연, 칙당선고신명, 연후전지여화, 유상재지.」 성종연지. 시성종, 낙모화풍, 국인불희, 고지백급지.
paragraphs.en: Hui submitted again: “The territory from the Khitan Eastern Capital to our Anbuk Garrison, several hundred li, was all held by the wild Jurchen; King Gwangjong took it and built the fortresses of Gaju, Songseong and others. Now the Khitan have come with no aim beyond seizing these two fortresses; their talk of taking the old land of Goguryeo is in truth meant to frighten us. To see their army’s great strength and suddenly cede the land north of the Western Capital to them is not sound planning. Moreover, the lands north of Mount Samgak are also old Goguryeo territory. With an appetite as deep as a ravine, they will demand without ever being satisfied; can we give it all away? And to cede land to an enemy is a shame for ten thousand generations. I beg Your Majesty to return to the capital and let your servants fight them once; to deliberate afterwards will not be too late.” Yi Ji-baek, formerly Director of the Office of Revenue (Mingwan), submitted: “Since the Sacred Ancestor founded the dynasty and handed down the line to this day, there has not been one loyal minister among us, that you would so suddenly think of handing land lightly to an enemy state. How can this not be lamentable? A poem of the ancients says: ‘A thousand li of mountains and rivers the boy-ruler made light of; the caps and swords of two reigns resent Qiao Zhou.’ It speaks of Qiao Zhou, a great minister of Shu, who urged the last ruler to yield his land to Wei, and was laughed at for a thousand ages. I ask that we send gold, silver and precious vessels to Son-nyeong as gifts, and see what he intends. And rather than lightly cede land and cast it to an enemy state, would it not be better to revive the practices of the former kings, the lantern festival, the Palgwan festival, the Seonrang youth, and not adopt the foreign ways of other lands, so as to preserve the state and bring about great peace? If you think so, then first announce it to the gods and spirits, and as for fighting or peace, it is for Your Majesty to decide.” Seongjong agreed. At this time Seongjong delighted in admiring Chinese ways, which the people did not like; that is why Ji-baek spoke of it.

paragraphs.orig: 遜寧以蒙戩旣還，久無回報，遂攻安戎鎭。中郞將大道秀、郞將庾方，與戰克之，遜寧不敢復進，遣人促降。成宗遣和通使閤門舍人張瑩，往契丹營，遜寧曰：「宜更以大臣，送軍前面對。」瑩還，成宗會群臣問曰：「誰能往契丹營，以口舌却兵，立萬世之功乎？」群臣無有應者，熙獨奏曰：「臣雖不敏，敢不惟命。」王出餞江頭，執手慰籍而送之。
paragraphs.reading: 손녕이몽전기환, 구무회보, 수공안융진. 중랑장대도수, 낭장유방, 여전극지, 손녕불감부진, 견인촉항. 성종견화통사합문사인장영, 왕거란영, 손녕왈: 「의경이대신, 송군전면대.」 영환, 성종회군신문왈: 「수능왕거란영, 이구설각병, 입만세지공호?」 군신무유응자, 희독주왈: 「신수불민, 감불유명.」 왕출전강두, 집수위적이송지.
paragraphs.en: Since Mong-jeon had already returned and no reply had come for a long time, Son-nyeong attacked Anyung Garrison. The generals Dae Do-su (Junglang-jang) and Yu Bang (Rangjang) fought him and defeated him, and Son-nyeong dared not advance further, and sent men to press for surrender. Seongjong sent the Peace Envoy and Palace Gate Secretary Jang Yeong to the Khitan camp, but Son-nyeong said: “You should send a senior minister instead, to meet me face to face before our army.” When Yeong returned, Seongjong assembled his ministers and asked: “Who can go to the Khitan camp and with his tongue alone turn back their soldiers, and so achieve a deed that will last ten thousand generations?” None of the ministers answered. Hui alone submitted: “Though I am not clever, how dare I not obey your command?” The king went out to the riverbank to bid him farewell, took his hand, comforted him, and sent him on his way.

paragraphs.orig: 熙奉國書，如遜寧營，使譯者問相見禮。遜寧曰：「我大朝貴人，宜拜於庭。」熙曰：「臣之於君，拜下禮也，兩國大臣相見，何得如是？」往復再三，遜寧不許。熙怒還，臥所館不起，遜寧心異之，乃許升堂行禮。於是，熙至營門，下馬而入。與遜寧分庭揖，升行禮，東西對坐。遜寧語熙曰：「汝國興新羅地，高勾麗之地，我所有也，而汝侵蝕之。又與我連壤，而越海事宋，故有今日之師。若割地以獻，而修朝聘，可無事矣。」熙曰：「非也。我國卽高勾麗之舊也，故號高麗，都平壤。若論地界，上國之東京，皆在我境，何得謂之侵蝕乎？且鴨綠江內外，亦我境內，今女眞盜據其閒，頑黠變詐，道途梗澁，甚於涉海。朝聘之不通，女眞之故也，若令逐女眞，還我舊地，築城堡通道路，則敢不修聘？將軍如以臣言，達之天聰，豈不哀納？」辭氣慷慨，遜寧知不可强，遂具以聞。契丹帝曰：「高麗旣請和，宜罷兵。」遜寧欲宴慰，熙曰：「本國雖無失道，而致上國勞師遠來，故上下皇皇，操戈執銳，暴露有日，何忍宴樂？」遜寧曰：「兩國大臣相見，可無歡好之禮乎？」固請，然後許之，極歡乃罷。熙留契丹營七日而還，遜寧贈以駝十首、馬百匹、羊千頭、錦綺羅紈五百匹。成宗大喜，出迎江頭，卽遣良柔爲禮幣使入覲。熙復奏曰：「臣與遜寧約，盪平女眞，收復舊地，然後朝覲可通，今纔收江內，請俟得江外，修聘未晩。」成宗曰：「久不修聘，恐有後患。」遂遣之。轉平章事。
paragraphs.reading: 희봉국서, 여손녕영, 사역자문상견례. 손녕왈: 「아대조귀인, 의배어정.」 희왈: 「신지어군, 배하례야, 양국대신상견, 하득여시?」 왕복재삼, 손녕불허. 희노환, 와소관불기, 손녕심이지, 내허승당행례. 어시, 희지영문, 하마이입. 여손녕분정읍, 승행례, 동서대좌. 손녕어희왈: 「여국흥신라지, 고구려지지, 아소유야, 이여침식지. 우여아연양, 이월해사송, 고유금일지사. 약할지이헌, 이수조빙, 가무사의.」 희왈: 「비야. 아국즉고구려지구야, 고호고려, 도평양. 약론지계, 상국지동경, 개재아경, 하득위지침식호? 차압록강내외, 역아경내, 금여진도거기간, 완힐변사, 도도경삽, 심어섭해. 조빙지불통, 여진지고야, 약령축여진, 환아구지, 축성보통도로, 칙감불수빙? 장군여이신언, 달지천총, 기불애납?」 사기강개, 손녕지불가강, 수구이문. 거란제왈: 「고려기청화, 의파병.」 손녕욕연위, 희왈: 「본국수무실도, 이치상국로사원래, 고상하황황, 조과집예, 폭로유일, 하인연락?」 손녕왈: 「양국대신상견, 가무환호지례호?」 고청, 연후허지, 극환내파. 희류거란영칠일이환, 손녕증이타십수, 마백필, 양천두, 금기라환오백필. 성종대희, 출영강두, 즉견양유위예폐사입근. 희부주왈: 「신여손녕약, 탕평여진, 수복구지, 연후조근가통, 금재수강내, 청사득강외, 수빙미만.」 성종왈: 「구불수빙, 공유후환.」 수견지. 전평장사.
paragraphs.en: Hui, bearing the royal letter, went to Son-nyeong’s camp and had an interpreter ask about the ceremony for meeting. Son-nyeong said: “I am a noble of the Great Dynasty; you must bow in the courtyard.” Hui said: “A subject before his lord bows below the steps; that is the rite. When ministers of two countries meet, how can it be so?” They went back and forth several times, but Son-nyeong would not yield. Hui, in anger, went back to his lodging, lay down and would not rise. Son-nyeong, struck by this, then allowed him to go up into the hall and perform the rite there. Thereupon Hui came to the camp gate, dismounted and entered. He and Son-nyeong bowed to each other from opposite sides of the courtyard, ascended and performed the rite, and sat facing each other, east and west. Son-nyeong said to Hui: “Your country arose on the land of Silla; the land of Goguryeo is ours, and you have nibbled away at it. Moreover, you border on us, yet cross the sea to serve Song, and that is why we have come with our army today. If you cede land and offer it to us and pay court with embassies, all will be well.” Hui said: “No. Our country is the very Goguryeo of old, and that is why it is called Goryeo, with its capital at Pyongyang. If we speak of boundaries, your Eastern Capital too lies within our territory; how can you call it nibbling? Moreover, the lands inside and outside the Amnok River are also within our borders. Now the Jurchen have stolen in and occupy the stretch between, stubborn, cunning and treacherous; the roads are blocked and rough, worse than crossing the sea. That our embassies do not get through is because of the Jurchen. If you drive out the Jurchen and return our old land to us, and let us build forts and open the roads, how would we dare not send embassies? If the General conveys my words to the Emperor’s ear, will he not graciously accept them?” His words and bearing were spirited and fearless; Son-nyeong knew that he could not be forced, and reported everything. The Khitan emperor said: “Goryeo has asked for peace; call off the army.” Son-nyeong wished to hold a banquet of consolation, but Hui said: “Though my country has not strayed from the Way, we have caused the Superior Country to send its army on a long journey, so that high and low are in fear and dread, taking up spear and sharp blade, exposed to the open for days. How can I bear to feast and make merry?” Son-nyeong said: “When ministers of two countries meet, can there be no rite of friendship?” He pressed the invitation, and only then did Hui consent; they made merry to the full and then parted. Hui stayed seven days in the Khitan camp and returned. Son-nyeong gave him ten camels, a hundred horses, a thousand sheep, and five hundred bolts of brocade, figured silk, gauze and fine silk. Seongjong was overjoyed and went out to the riverbank to meet him, and at once sent Park Yang-yu as envoy bearing gifts to go to the Khitan court. Hui submitted again: “I made an agreement with Son-nyeong that once the Jurchen were swept clean and the old land recovered, court visits could proceed. Now we have recovered only the land inside the river. I beg you to wait until we have gained the land beyond the river; it will not be too late to send an embassy then.” Seongjong said: “If we long fail to send an embassy, I fear future trouble.” And so he sent Yang-yu. Hui was promoted to Chief State Councillor.

paragraphs.orig: 十三年，率兵逐女眞，城長興、歸化二鎭，郭、龜二州。明年又率兵，城安義、興化二鎭，又明年，城宣、孟二州。
paragraphs.reading: 십삼년, 솔병축여진, 성장흥, 귀화이진, 곽, 구이주. 명년우솔병, 성안의, 흥화이진, 우명년, 성선, 맹이주.
paragraphs.en: In the thirteenth year he led troops to drive out the Jurchen and built walls for the two garrisons of Jangheung and Gwihwa, and for the two prefectures of Gwak and Gu. The next year he again led troops and walled the two garrisons of Anui and Heunghwa; and the year after that, he walled the two prefectures of Seon and Maeng.

paragraphs.orig: 熙嘗扈駕海州，成宗幸熙幕欲入，熙曰：「臣之幕，非至尊所當臨。」命進酒曰：「臣之酒不堪獻也。」成宗乃坐幕外，進御酒共飮而罷。
paragraphs.reading: 희상호가해주, 성종행희막욕입, 희왈: 「신지막, 비지존소당림.」 명진주왈: 「신지주불감헌야.」 성종내좌막외, 진어주공음이파.
paragraphs.en: Hui once accompanied the royal carriage to Haeju. King Seongjong came to Hui’s tent and wished to enter, but Hui said: “My tent is not a place where Your Supreme Majesty should deign to come.” He ordered wine to be served, saying: “My wine is not fit to be offered.” So Seongjong sat outside the tent, and the royal wine was brought, and they drank together before parting.

paragraphs.orig: 供賓令鄭又玄，上封事論時政七事，忤旨。成宗會宰相議曰：「又玄敢越職論事，罪之何如？」皆曰：「惟命。」熙曰：「古者諫無官，越職何罪？臣以不才，謬居宰相，竊位素餐，使官卑者，論政敎得失，是臣之罪也。况又玄論事甚切，宜加褒獎。」成宗感悟，擢又玄監察御史，賜熙繡鞍廐馬、酒果，以慰之，拜太保、內史令。
paragraphs.reading: 공빈령정우현, 상봉사논시정칠사, 오지. 성종회재상의왈: 「우현감월직논사, 죄지하여?」 개왈: 「유명.」 희왈: 「고자간무관, 월직하죄? 신이부재, 류거재상, 절위소찬, 사관비자, 논정교득실, 시신지죄야. 황우현논사심절, 의가포장.」 성종감오, 탁우현감찰어사, 사희수안구마, 주과, 이위지, 배태보, 내사령.
paragraphs.en: Jeong U-hyeon, Director of the Office of Guest Provisions, submitted a sealed memorial discussing seven matters of current government, and it offended the king’s wishes. Seongjong convened the chief ministers and said: “U-hyeon has dared to overstep his office and discuss affairs of state. What should be done to punish him?” All said: “We await your command.” Hui said: “In ancient times there was no office for remonstrance; what crime is there in overstepping one’s post? I, though untalented, wrongly hold the post of chancellor, occupying a seat and eating my fill for nothing; if I let a man of low rank be the one to discuss the gains and losses of government and teaching, that is my own fault. Moreover, U-hyeon’s arguments are most pointed, and he ought to be praised and rewarded.” Seongjong was moved and enlightened; he raised U-hyeon to Censor, gave Hui an embroidered saddle, a horse from the royal stables, wine and fruit to console him, and appointed him Grand Guardian and Director of the Naesa.

paragraphs.orig: 十五年，熙患疾，在開國寺，成宗駕幸問疾，以御衣一襲、馬三匹，分施寺院。又以穀一千石，施開國寺，凡所以祈命者，無所不爲。明年頒祿，熙病尙未愈，命有司曰：「熙年雖未及致仕，以疾病未得侍朝，宜給致仕祿。」
paragraphs.reading: 십오년, 희환질, 재개국사, 성종가행문질, 이어의일습, 마삼필, 분시사원. 우이곡일천석, 시개국사, 범소이기명자, 무소불위. 명년반록, 희병상미유, 명유사왈: 「희년수미급치사, 이질병미득시조, 의급치사록.」
paragraphs.en: In the fifteenth year, Hui fell ill and was staying at Gaeguk Temple. King Seongjong came in his carriage to ask after his illness, and donated a set of royal robes and three horses, divided among the temples. He also gave a thousand seok of grain to Gaeguk Temple; there was nothing he did not do to pray for Hui’s life. The next year, when stipends were being distributed, Hui’s illness had still not been cured, and the king ordered the officials: “Although Hui has not reached the age of retirement, he cannot attend court because of his illness; he should be given a retirement stipend.”

paragraphs.orig: 穆宗元年卒，年五十七，聞訃震悼，賻布一千匹，麥三百石，米五百石，腦原茶二百角，大茶十斤，栴香三百兩，以禮葬之，謚章威。顯宗十八年，配享成宗廟庭，德宗二年，加贈太師。子訥，側室子周行。
paragraphs.reading: 목종원년졸, 년오십칠, 문부진도, 부포일천필, 맥삼백석, 미오백석, 뇌원다이백각, 대다십근, 전향삼백량, 이례장지, 시장위. 현종십팔년, 배향성종묘정, 덕종이년, 가증태사. 자눌, 측실자주행.
paragraphs.en: He died in the first year of King Mokjong, at the age of fifty-seven. On hearing the news the king was shaken with grief, and sent as funeral gifts a thousand bolts of cloth, three hundred seok of barley, five hundred seok of rice, two hundred pieces of Noewon tea, ten geun of great tea, and three hundred nyang of sandalwood incense, and had him buried with due ceremony; his posthumous title was Jangwi. In the eighteenth year of Hyeonjong he was enshrined as a companion in the courtyard of Seongjong’s shrine, and in the second year of Deokjong he was posthumously raised to Grand Preceptor. His son was Nul, and his son by a secondary wife was Juhaeng.

review.notes: Right work: the 徐熙 biography only (14 paragraphs; the Seo Hui-Xiao Sunning negotiation of 993 is in the middle, ends at the end of his entry), original text with PD basis. Card and notes rewritten for the biography and checked against the text. validate.py reports no en for the explicit original-only list, as expected. Author/context sections added 2026-10-08 and fact-checked by an independent reviewer (batch 1). Fixes: heading (0) changed to neutral 'Seo Hui, Seo Nul and Seo Gong' since the text only mentions Nul (son) and Juhaeng (son by a secondary wife) and never explains 恭; (4) 'Imperial Secretary' -> Palace Secretary (給事中) and 不恤民事 rendered as 'no care for the welfare of its people'; (5) Seo Hui's rhetorical 寧為敵所資 clarified; (6) 民官 is the Office of Revenue, not Civil Affairs; (7) generals' titles glossed; (8) 鴨綠江內外 / 盜據其閒 made more exact; (11) 供賓令 title; (12) donation to temples; (13) 配享 wording. Readings: 復行 -> 부행 (6), 郞將 -> 낭장 (7); other polyphonics (率, 降, 樂, 數, 更, 行, 不 before ㅈ/ㄷ) verified correct.
